summary.headline: Saturn in Leo and Virgo
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for Saturn’s entry into Leo and Virgo, covering weather, agriculture, disease, warfare, political disorder, prices, and regional upheaval. Authorities cited include Ahmad Abd al-Jalil, Hasib Makki, Taj al-Din Akram, Hermes the Sage, and Ptolemy, with references to Balkh, Kashgar, Ferghana, Samarkand, Lesser Armenia, Babylon, Bab al-Abwab, Dasht-i Qipchaq, and eastern Khorasan.
